en.name: Zoom-to-Cursor Effect
en.title: Zoom-to-Cursor Effect: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: The camera pushes into a UI element in 0.6s, holds for one click or drag, then pulls back. Make this zoom-to-cursor effect with Claude Code or Codex.
howto: Put the whole calendar window in one container and scale it 2× on each push, translating the target element to the frame center (960, 540) with transform-origin at the container top-left. Push in over 0.6s with expo.out, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), hold 2.35–2.75s, then pull back in 0.7s on the same easing.

The camera arrives first and the cursor starts moving 0.1s after the push completes. Add a CSS blur of 3px on each push and 2px on each pull (0.12s up, 0.3s down) as motion blur. Each pull-back starts 0.7–0.85s after the action, while the toast is still showing. The two actions are dragging a card to the next day and clicking an empty slot to type a title.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent rebuilds the window in DOM so text stays sharp at 2×. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.
faq: Zoom-to-cursor is an effect in which the view zooms toward the pointer or the element being used, holds while the action happens, then returns to the full view. It keeps small UI actions legible in a recording.
How long should each zoom be?
This recipe uses 0.6s for each push-in and 0.7s for each pull-back on the same expo.out ease, with one action per zoom. Short moves keep the viewer oriented in the full page.

zh.name: 光标自动放大效果
zh.title: 光标自动放大效果：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 镜头用 0.6s 快推到要操作的元素，完成一次点击或拖动后拉回。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个光标自动放大效果。
howto: 把整个日历窗口放进同一个容器，每次推近缩放 2 倍，把目标元素平移到画面中心（960, 540），transform-origin 设在容器左上角。推近用 0.6s，缓动 expo.out（cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)），停留 2.35–2.75s，再用同一条缓动在 0.7s 内拉回。
镜头先到位，推近完成 0.1s 后光标才开始移动。每次推近加 3px 的 CSS 模糊，每次拉回加 2px（0.12s 升起、0.3s 回落），作为运动模糊。每次拉回在操作完成 0.7–0.85s 后开始，此时提示条仍在显示。两个操作分别是把卡片拖到第二天，以及点击空时段并输入标题。
点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用 DOM 重建窗口，保证 2 倍放大后文字仍然清晰。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。
faq: 光标自动放大指画面自动推近到指针或正在操作的元素，操作期间保持，结束后回到全景。它让录屏里的小操作看得清。
这份配方每次推近 0.6s、每次拉回 0.7s，缓动同为 expo.out，每次放大只服务一个操作。动作短，观众能一直知道自己在整页的哪个位置。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
